Experience reading and interpreting technical, safety and MSDS documentation as it relates to the use of chemicals, equipment, and tools.

Supervisory experience in custodial operations or applicable field, including recruiting and training employees, assigning and reviewing work, establishing expectations, evaluating performance, recognizing achievements, and addressing performance or conduct concerns through appropriate corrective action.
Day Shift (6:00 AM – 3:00 PM); Swing Shift (4:30 PM – 1:30 AM); Night Shift (9:45 PM – 6:45AM)

items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
High school diploma and/or equivalent experience.

Supervisory experience in custodial operations or applicable field, including recruiting and training employees, assigning and reviewing work, establishing expectations, evaluating performance, recognizing achievements, and addressing performance or conduct concerns through appropriate corrective action.
Experience reading and interpreting technical, safety and MSDS documentation as it relates to the use of chemicals, equipment, and tools.

Experience safely operating and maintaining custodial tools and equipment, including wet and dry mops, standard and high-speed floor machines, square buffers, carpet extractors, upright and backpack vacuums, wet/dry vacuums, mop buckets and wringers, and electric or battery-powered automatic scrubbers.

Experience using computers and software applications, including Microsoft Windows, Word, and Excel, and reading and interpreting technical instructions, safety materials, and Safety Data Sheets related to custodial chemicals, equipment, and tools.

These positions report to the Principal Custodial Supervisor. Under supervision, oversee employees within an assigned core. Assists the Principal Custodial Supervisor with the following: Performs monthly building audits; provides training and/or retraining of staff; oversees special project work; inventories equipment and keys; ensures equipment is properly maintained; assists in supply orders and locker inventory; reviews work orders and performs follow up inspections for completion of work needed; works with senior supervisor on performance issues; writes and conducts performance appraisals; conducts safety and tailgate meetings; provides back up coverage for supervisor and well as station coverage. Ensures equipment is properly maintained and custodial inventory is maintained. May assist other supervisors.

Knowledge of custodial cleaning methods, equipment, chemicals, and techniques required to maintain buildings with varied uses, including established procedures for safely handling hazardous materials and toxic waste and the ability to develop and conduct technical and safety training.
Knowledge of cleaning functions and related custodial techniques necessary to care for buildings used for a variety of different purposes on a large campus.

Oral, written, and interpersonal communication and customer service skills to interact effectively with employees and members of the campus community; respond to work requests, questions, complaints, and performance concerns; provide clear reports and instructions; and follow through to resolve issues.
Knowledge and skill to develop and conduct technical training and safety programs.

Organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills to independently prioritize and assign work, manage multiple competing projects, meet deadlines, maintain productivity, develop effective work processes, and respond flexibly to changing or unfamiliar assignments. Ability to learn and navigate campus building locations.
Skill to develop creative solutions to general problems attempt unfamiliar projects/assignments and respond with flexibility to requests for assistance.
Knowledge of campus building locations helpful.
